## Summary

Alder Mews Architects (policy CC-1518): accidental drop during transport of a tablet and a drawing display at a hotel meeting room in Leeds. Covered under clause 4.5; reserve 3,642 dollars.

## Facts

Alder Mews Architects reported the loss on 25 June 2026 [notice of loss]. The policy number is CC-1518 [notice of loss]. The loss was an accidental drop during transport [notice of loss], [incident report]. It occurred at a hotel meeting room in Leeds [notice of loss], [incident report]. The items are a tablet and a drawing display [incident report], [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 27 June 2026 under reference IR/2026/4182 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. The file does not state who was carrying the items or between which premises they were being carried [notice of loss], [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.5 of the policy, which covers accidental loss of or damage to portable equipment while being carried by an employee between premises [policy]. Clause 4.2 does not respond, because it covers only theft, fire, storm or escape of water, and none of these is reported [policy], [notice of loss]. Clauses 4.7 and 4.9 do not apply, because no escape of water or electrical surge is reported [policy], [incident report].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: it concerns theft of unattended portable equipment, and no theft is alleged [policy], [incident report]. Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: it concerns gradual deterioration, and the loss is reported as a single accidental drop [policy], [incident report]. Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it operates only where theft is alleged, and no theft is alleged [policy], [incident report].

The file does not record that an employee was carrying the items or that they were between premises, which are elements of clause 4.5 [policy]. These two points should be confirmed with the insured before payment.

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.5. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming the two transit details noted above.

## Reserve

The reserve is 3,642 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (2,018 dollars and 1,624 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The policy extract in the file shows no schedule excess, so under clause 9.1 none applies [policy].
